prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Spectrum 1-1: page #F9FBFA, text #1F2D2A, accent #1D5986, secondary surface #EEE7EF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Libre Baskerville; direct grotesque heading with measured reading serif. Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Use body 16px, heading 28px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 24px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
